race.description: Become A Redcliffe Hrc Member Up To 2 Wins Pace
race.comment: LUCKY JESS (2) ran third last start at Albion Park over 1660m, beaten 5.5 metres. Sure to enjoy an economical run from this draw. Has the talent to take care of this field. LOUARK (6) settled close to the pace but couldn't finish the race off and could only manage sixth last start over 1660m at Albion Park, that effort coming after a win at this track the run before. Won't find this any harder and he can finish a lot closer this time. ATULA NZ (8) disappointed last time when 11th over 2138m at Albion Park. Can bounce back. REAL MIKI (9) is a first four hope.
